title: safe-delete
summary: Deletes a symbol if and only if it has zero references in the index
intro: Read this when you want to remove dead code without breaking a live caller: safe-delete deletes a symbol only if the index shows zero references to it.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint safe-delete --name <QName> [--json|--apply|--no-backup] --db <db> - delete a symbol iff it has zero references
help: drag-lint safe-delete --name <QName> [--json|--apply|--no-backup] --db <db>   - delete a symbol iff it has zero references

steps: Put the caret on the symbol in the editor
It deletes only when the index finds zero references; otherwise it refuses

questions.ask: Can I delete this symbol without breaking anything?
How do I actually delete it once it has no references?
